title: fix(platform-objects): distinct zh-CN/ja-JP labels for the two Setup organization nav entries
body:
Refs #25176

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Setup → People & Organization carries `nav_organization` (the active organization's record page) and `nav_organizations` (the organization list, shown where `org-scoping` is mounted). Both translated to 「组织」 in zh-CN and 「組織」 in ja-JP, so a multi-organization deployment showed two identical entries that open different pages.

- zh-CN: 「当前组织」 / 「所有组织」
- ja-JP: 「現在の組織」 / 「すべての組織」
- New `setup-nav-distinct-labels.test.ts`: fails when two entries in one Setup nav group read the same in any shipped locale (en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES). Verified red on the old translations, green after.
- `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

Only translated-locale values change; no translation keys are added or dropped, and the English source (and so the source hashes) is unchanged.
